Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in g for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(a,b,g[a][b]) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if g[a][b]!=bg]

    maj=min(c for _,c in mc);  # careful: majority color = most common
    maj=max(m.values())
    minority=mc[maj]  # wrong; redo
    order=[c for c,_ in mc]  # desc frequency
    minority=order[0]; major=order[-1]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg:
                ds=sorted((abs(a-i)+abs(b-j),v) for a,b,v in seeds)
                d=v=None
                for dd,v in ds:

from collections import deque, Counter
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in g for v in r_)
    flat=sorted(((v,c) for v,c in cnt.items()), key=lambda x:-x[1])
    struct=[v for v,_ in flat[:2]]
    seeds=[(a,b,g[a][b]) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if g[a][b] not in struct]
    m=Counter(v for _,_,v in seeds)
    mc=max(m.values()); major=[v for v,n in m.items() if n==mc]
    minor=[v for v,n in m.items() if n<mc]
    bgcnt=most=None
    # determine bg: most common overall
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    D=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]; par=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]
    q=deque()
    for a,b,v in seeds:
        D[a][b]=0; par[a][b]=(a,b,v); q.append((a,b,v))
    while q:
        aa,bb,cv=q.popleft()
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            na,nb=aa+dr,bb+dc
            if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb]==bg and D[na][nb] is None:
                D[na][nb]=D[aa][bb]+1; par[na][nb]=(aa,bb,cv); q.append((na,nb,cv))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg and D[i][j] is not None:
                d=D[i][j]
                exp = major[0] if d%2==0 else minor[0]
                out[i][j]=exp
    return out
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(nm, solve(G[nm+' input'])==G[nm+' output'])

    colors={v:c for _,_,c in seeds}; other=[c for c in colors.values() if c!=list(colors.values())[0]][0] if len(set(colors.values()))>1 else None
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    D=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]; par=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]
    q=deque()
    for a,b,v in seeds:

    def inb(x,y): return 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w
